package.name: servo_state_probe
package.description: Diagnostic probe: an independent moveit::core::RobotModel + CurrentStateMonitor subscribed to the same joint_states topic moveit_servo uses, so we can tell whether Servo's frozen output comes from the topic/monitor layer or from Servo's own instance. Throwaway tool, see docs/servo/2026-11-02-servo-state-monitor-stuck.md §6.
